what: In real builds `behind` names the blocker's own unit (`["libc 0.2.189 lib (host)", "libc 0.2.189 lib (host)"]`: its later stages), not other units, so the stream says how many tasks wait on a unit and never which. A tree of the graph cannot be drawn from the build's events.
cost: the tree layout could only be tried from Cargo.lock in a throwaway script
cause: names are taken by unit, and a unit's own later tasks come first
workaround: the screen shows the count (`← 22 wait on it`)
fix: the fold names units other than the blocker's own
